mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_NOTIFICATION.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TBL_NOTIFICATION (NOTIFICATION_ID, RECEIVER_TYPE, MEMBER_ID, NTF_TYPE, NTF_DETAIL, NTF_TITLE, NTF_CONTENT, LINK_URL, IS_IMPORTANT, IS_READ, NTF_CHANNEL, CREATED_AT, SENT_AT) VALUES (#{notificationId}, #{receiverType}, #{memberId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{ntfType}, #{ntfDetail}, #{ntfTitle}, #{ntfContent}, #{linkUrl,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{isImportant}, 'N', #{ntfChannel}, SYSDATE, SYSDATENULL)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_NOTIFICATION WHERE RECEIVER_TYPE = '01' AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND IS_READ = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_NOTIFICATION SET IS_READ = 'Y' WHERE RECEIVER_TYPE = '01' AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND IS_READ = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT PHONE FROM TBL_MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND IS_ACTIVE = 'Y'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_NOTIFICATION WHERE RECEIVER_TYPE = '02' AND IS_READ = 'N' AND CREATED_AT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - #{days}
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_NOTIFICATION SET IS_READ = 'Y' WHERE NOTIFICATION_ID = #{notificationId} AND RECEIVER_TYPE = '02'
UPDATE TBL_NOTIFICATION SET IS_READ = 'Y' WHERE RECEIVER_TYPE = '02' AND IS_READ = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT PHONE FROM TBL_ADMIN WHERE IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND PUSH_ENABLED = 'Y' ORDER BY ADMIN_ID
SELECT PUSH_ENABLED FROM TBL_ADMIN WHERE ADMIN_ID = #{adminId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_ADMIN SET PUSH_ENABLED = #{pushEnabled} WHERE ADMIN_ID = #{adminId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_NOTIFICATION N LEFT JOIN TBL_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = N.MEMBER_ID
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_NOTIFICATION WHERE RECEIVER_TYPE = '01' AND SENT_AT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_NOTIFICATION WHERE RECEIVER_TYPE = '01' AND SENT_AT IS NULL
SELECT FROM TBL_NOTIFICATION N WHERE N.RECEIVER_TYPE = '01' AND N.SENT_AT IS NULL ORDER BY N.NOTIFICATION_ID
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_NOTIFICATION SET NTF_CHANNEL = #{channel} WHERE NOTIFICATION_ID = #{notificationId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT SETTING_ID, IS_ACTIVE, QUIET_ENABLED, QUIET_START, QUIET_END, SMS_FALLBACK, UPDATED_AT, ADMIN_ID FROM TBL_NOTIFICATION_SETTING ORDER BY SETTING_ID ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_NOTIFICATION_SETTING.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TBL_NOTIFICATION_SETTING (SETTING_ID, IS_ACTIVE, QUIET_ENABLED, QUIET_START, QUIET_END, SMS_FALLBACK, ADMIN_ID) VALUES (#{settingId}, #{isActive}, #{quietEnabled}, #{quietStart,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{quietEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{smsFallback}, #{adminId,jdbcType=NUMERIC})
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_NOTIFICATION_SETTING SET IS_ACTIVE = #{isActive}, QUIET_ENABLED = #{quietEnabled}, QUIET_START = #{quietStart,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, QUIET_END = #{quietEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SMS_FALLBACK = #{smsFallback}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE, ADMIN_ID = #{adminId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} WHERE SETTING_ID = #{settingId}
mapper.select: SELECT R.RESERVATION_ID, M.MEMBER_ID, R.MOVE_DATE, R.MOVE_TIME FROM TBL_RESERVATION R JOIN TBL_MOVE_REQUEST M ON M.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID JOIN TBL_MEMBER B ON B.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID WHERE R.STATUS = '01' AND R.MOVE_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) + #{days} AND R.MOVE_DATE < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + #{days} + 1 AND B.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TBL_NOTIFICATION N WHERE N.RECEIVER_TYPE = '01' AND N.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID AND N.NTF_DETAIL = '07' AND N.LINK_URL = '/reservations/' || R.RESERVATION_ID) ORDER BY R.RESERVATION_ID
